subject.title: Feature request: Read pinned Telegram messages via bot API

question: Should Telegram pinned-message reads be exposed as an on-demand message action only, or should OpenClaw also inject pinned content automatically at session start?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent behavior decides how durable Telegram room context is authorized, gated, surfaced to agents, and documented.

options.title: On-demand gated read
options.body: Expose a Telegram list-pins/read-pinned action through the plugin with a dedicated action gate and live Telegram proof, leaving automatic prompt injection out of scope.

options.title: Automatic pinned context
options.body: Add session-start pinned-message injection as an opt-in configuration surface after defining privacy, prompt-injection, and refresh semantics.

options.title: Defer to broader read design
options.body: Keep this blocked until maintainers settle the broader Telegram message-read and retained-context contract tracked separately.

recommendation.title: On-demand gated read
recommendation.body: Expose a Telegram list-pins/read-pinned action through the plugin with a dedicated action gate and live Telegram proof, leaving automatic prompt injection out of scope.

likelyOwner.reason: They are already tied to the current source snapshot and the visible product/security review trail for this Telegram area.
